messages.content: For user_001, please look up electronics from Sony and show me up to 10 results in the electronics category. Then check similar recommendations for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, pick the silver version as the alternative, and set the quantity to 2. After that, hold those 2 items and confirm the order. Once that’s done, check my checking account balance and use that balance information to create a medium-priority in-app note titled Trip Summary with the tags finance and travel.
